formulas.formula: See your debt-free date, compare payoff methods, and track your progress.
1. My Debts: list each debt with its balance, interest rate (APR) and minimum payment.
2. Add what extra you can pay each month on top of the minimums, and the month you start.
3. Expecting a tax refund or bonus? Add it under One-Time Payments with the month it comes in.
4. Open Compare: snowball, avalanche and your own custom order side by side, plus minimums only.
5. Each plan has its own tab: payoff order, debt-free date and a month-by-month schedule.
6. Pick the plan you'll follow on My Debts, then log your real total balance on Progress each month.
7. Change anything (a new debt, a bigger extra payment) and every plan updates instantly.
Smallest balance first. Quick wins keep you motivated.
Highest interest rate first. Saves the most money.
Your own order: type 1, 2, 3... in the Custom Order column (for example, the debt that stresses you most first).
When a debt is paid off, its minimum rolls into the next one, so your monthly total stays the same and the payoff speeds up.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: paid off, ahead of plan, or the best option.
Red: something to check (a typo, or a payment too low to ever pay the debt off).
This calculator is an estimate: real statements can differ a little (interest is figured monthly here).
Thank you for your purchase! Every payment is a step toward freedom.
List your debts. Balance and minimum from your latest statements; rate is the APR (type 22.99 or 22.99%).
On top of all the minimums. It goes to the first debt in the plan's order.
The month of your first plan payment (use the month after your statement balances).
Snowball, Avalanche or Custom. Progress compares your real balance to this plan.

section_bars.label: DEBT LEFT OVER TIME: SNOWBALL (GREEN), AVALANCHE (ORANGE), CUSTOM (BLUE)
